reviewed_gates: New-only v3; five-case order, unchanged historical loader/training helpers; three loads and six updates maximum, fixed seed503 and training-only data.

Explicit installed provider-source exact file/path hashes. One AF_INET6=23/SOCK_STREAM=1/proto0 bind of tuple(::1,0) during import; exact two-frame source/function/line prefix, outside-package boundary; all other audited bind/connect/DNS/sendto rejected.

Four event receipts maximum; nine scanned/eight retained frame upper bounds, bounded source reads, no raw endpoint/hostname/locals/user paths. Overflow, unreadable/mismatched metadata, extra denial and changed cumulative prefix fail acceptance.
Propagating worker exceptions save bounded guard/phase/time; controller authenticates raw failure and cannot silently accept it. Stage-specific guard error avoids misleading PID/thread attribution.

Current frozen roles, retained OS image and self path distinct; timestamped sequential control acceptance precedes work; actual loader and two-step dense helper; synchronized memory brackets, held descriptive overhead, busy/deadline/private threshold and whole Job cleanup.
Exact raw controls and stage/terminal receipt custody replayed independently; portable checker imports no producer/ML and starts no processes.

Mock/receipt mutation tests reviewed for wrong source/caller/endpoint/phase, duplicate/drop/overflow, propagated denial, hidden failure, counters, identity, control clocks, training contract, sampled liveness/memory and cleanup.
limitations: Read-only source inspection and guarded unit tests precede a new experiment, not evidence that actual v3 acceptance succeeds.
Python audit policy is not native I/O isolation; bounded package prefix is not a whole import stack.
Held snapshots cannot establish continuous child absence or loaded-code integrity. Current brackets and lifetime peaks are not isolated backward peaks; sampled cap permits overshoot.
Descriptive held off/on windows do not measure causal training slowdown. Scientific compression/final-quality failures and historical invalid parent RSS stay unchanged.
